subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

Travelling __is the best__ method to utilise time.
solution:
The correct answer is "**No improvement required**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence needs no improvement as it is correct.
 
• Travelling is being said to be the best method to utilise time.
 
• Thus, a **superlative degree **is used.
 
• We always use definite article before a superlative degree.
 
 
• E
